notes: Event switch convention (verified on several flows): IsGameDataBool / IsExistInPouch case 0 = true, case 1 = false; IsGameDataInt case 0 = below Value, 1 = equal, 2 = above.

Many flows query GameData 'IsGet.<ActorName>' (set automatically on obtaining that pouch actor) to decide repeats or text: Great Fairies, scrubs, sages. A randomized gift leaves the vanilla item's IsGet flag false.
